::: {#def-device}

#### Device

A [tensor](#def-tensor)'s **device** is the processor whose memory holds its entries,
and on which operations on the tensor run:
the CPU, or a GPU (in PyTorch, `"cuda"` for an NVIDIA GPU).
PyTorch makes a tensor on the CPU unless told otherwise,
`.to()` copies a tensor to another device,
and an operation on two [tensors](#def-tensor) needs both on the same device.

:::
